steps.command: cd /app && xxd main.db | head -40 && echo "=== WAL ===" && xxd main.db-wal | head -60

cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
data=bytearray(open('main.db-wal','rb').read())
fixed=bytes(b^0x42 for b in data)
open('main.db-wal.fixed','wb').write(fixed)
import struct
print(fixed[:32].hex())
magic,ver,psz,ckpt,s1,s2,c1,c2=struct.unpack('>8I',fixed[:32])
print(hex(magic),ver,psz,ckpt,hex(s1),hex(s2))
print('frame count',(len(fixed)-32)/(psz+24))
EOF

cd /app && cp main.db /tmp/test.db && cp main.db-wal.fixed /tmp/test.db-wal && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('/tmp/test.db')
print(c.execute("select name,sql from sqlite_master").fetchall())
print(c.execute("select * from items order by id").fetchall())
c.close()
EOF

cd /app && cp main.db-wal.fixed main.db-wal && rm -f main.db-wal.fixed && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sqlite3, json
c=sqlite3.connect('file:/tmp/test.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
rows=[{'id':r[0],'name':r[1],'value':r[2]} for r in c.execute('select id,name,value from items order by id')]
c.close()
with open('/app/recovered.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(rows,f)
print(len(rows))
print(open('/app/recovered.json').read())
EOF
ls -la /app

cd /app && python3 -c "import sqlite3;c=sqlite3.connect('file:main.db?mode=ro',uri=True);print(c.execute('select count(*),sum(value) from items').fetchone());c.close()" && python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('recovered.json'));print(len(d), d[-1])"
